Make trust measurable across the health ecosystem

The Health Trust Index is a survey-led, annual PwC benchmark and thought leadership publication designed to measure how consumers trust the organisations, platforms and services shaping health, what drives that trust and where leaders can act.

01 Why trust, why now

Trust has become both the price of entry and the licence to grow

Health players increasingly engage consumers directly, while expectations are set by consumer-native industries. Yet leadership teams still lack a consistent way to quantify trust, diagnose its drivers and track progress.

Consumerisation changes the benchmark

The shift to direct-to-consumer engagement means health brands are judged against the simplicity and responsiveness of leading consumer experiences

Trust is increasingly public and fragile

Digital channels and event-driven scrutiny amplify changes in perception quickly and visibly

There is no shared trust KPI

Leaders need a credible, repeatable benchmark to understand the gap, identify the levers and measure movement over time

PwC response

A benchmark that creates a repeatable market moment

HTI makes trust visible and actionable, positioning PwC to lead the trust conversation across the wider health ecosystem and translate insight into client engagement.

  • Bring together Health Industries, Consumer Markets and Technology perspectives
  • Launch a distinctive point of view and spark stakeholder attention
  • Anchor executive conversations in proprietary consumer evidence
  • Connect trust gaps to clear intervention pathways and downstream work
  • Build credibility and value through an annual dataset that compounds year on year
02 HTI in one minute

A simple benchmark built around one focused question

How do consumers assess the wider health ecosystem against the dimensions that define trust?
1 How trusted is each health sector?
2 What drives or erodes that trust?
3 What should leaders do next?

Six sectors, one comparable view

The inaugural edition benchmarks consumer trust across the health ecosystem, allowing leaders to see where sectors stand and which trust dimensions matter most.

Cross-sector by design

Built across three PwC sector communities

Consumer health no longer sits within one traditional industry boundary. HTI brings together the perspectives needed to reflect the ecosystem consumers actually encounter.

Health Industries

Pharma, providers, payers, MedTech and the clinical ecosystem

Consumer Markets

Retail health, pharmacy, consumer expectations and routes to market

Technology

Final product

Published as a PwC thought leadership paper

The benchmark will be brought to market through a recurring annual PwC publication combining trust scores, the dimensions behind them, market commentary and implications for leaders across the health ecosystem.

Five dimensions capture how consumers experience trust

Together, the five dimensions provide a structured view of consumer trust. Select a dimension to see its assessment focus and indicators.

HTITrust score
Trust dimension

Transparency

Do consumers clearly understand what products and services do, and do they feel that pricing, terms and data use are honestly explained?

Ease of finding essential informationClarity of usage and benefitsClarity of risks and side effectsClarity of costs and termsClarity of data use explanations

Survey-led, transparent and designed to be actionable

The methodology is intentionally easy to explain: ask the right consumers, score the trust dimensions and translate the findings into a comparable benchmark, with limited local tailoring only where essential.

1

Listen

Survey consumers across participating markets

2

Measure

Score indicators across the five dimensions and aggregate them into sector-level trust scores

3

Activate

Identify the drivers and translate them into market narratives, executive conversations and intervention pathways

Primary evidence comes from the survey. External benchmarks and online social sentiment analysis may be used as supporting context where they add value.

Establish the baseline, then repeat and deepen it every year

The inaugural publication creates a credible sector-level benchmark. Each annual edition refreshes the data, tracks movement and can add more granular views.

05 Designed for credibility

Useful to clients without compromising trust

The safeguards matter, but they do not need to dominate the story. HTI embeds them into the design and governance from the outset.

✓

Survey-led and transparent

Primary research generates distinctive insight, supported by disclosed scoring, weighting and comparability principles.

✓

Controlled disclosure

Public outputs focus on relevant sector insights, while more sensitive comparisons can be handled through private client views.

✓

Leadership review and independence

PwC review gates protect tone and account sensitivities while preserving editorial independence of the findings.

View the full safeguard set
Robust survey screening, sample design and data-quality controls
Transparent methodology, scoring logic and weighting approach
Expert and client input into framework design without influence over outcomes
Private benchmark options for precise scores and peer comparisons
Advisory and leadership review before publication
Framing that compares pharma with adjacent health and consumer sectors
